args: Implement docs/plans/bylaw-one-guide-plan.md: open one draft PR with the preview URL at the top; Part 1 write docs/site-map.md giving every page one job, drive header and footer from one navigation config with no destination in both, remove duplicate links and buttons in page bodies, send Map and "Find rules by place" to the same route, list gaps once from declarations, make every repeated figure come from one generated value, and add CI checks for duplicate links and inconsistent figures; Part 2 write the guide as source files in content/guide/ with slide summaries, presenter notes and reading versions, generated figures, Mermaid diagrams and Playwright screenshots, using the content brief in Section 6 for narrative, principles, offers, timeline and sustainability; Part 3 build /guide in reading mode with audience entry points, contents and Present and Download buttons; Part 4 build /guide/slides with reveal.js and speaker view in the Bylaw One look; Part 5 build bylaw-one-guide.html as a single self-contained offline file with both modes, tested with the network disabled; describe the agent engine, packs and installers as planned; commit and push after each part, keep docs/progress.md current and the PR's "For owner review", "Decisions made" and "Known gaps" sections up to date; never invent or rewrite legal text.
